description: Edit a role's name, color (solid, gradient, or holographic), icon, hoist, mentionable flag, or permissions. Passing preset and/or permissions replaces the role's permission set with the named bundle plus listed names. Only passed fields change. Supports dry_run. A permission change that would give the role moderator or admin powers (such as banning, kicking, or timing out members, deleting other people's messages, or managing the server, roles, or channels), or let it see channels it cannot see now, needs confirming: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirm_token, and repeating the call with the token makes the change. Role "@everyone" takes permissions only, and any change to it needs confirming, since every member holds it.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

hoist.description: Show members with this role as their own group in the member list.

holographic.description: Discord's holographic style, which uses its own three colors; false for a solid color. Needs the Enhanced Role Colors server feature.

icon_emoji.description: A standard emoji shown beside members' names instead of an image, or none to remove. Needs boost level 2.

icon_file.description: The icon image from the local files folder (DISCORD_MCP_FILES_DIR), by name, instead of icon_url. Needs boost level 2.

icon_url.description: Public URL of a small image (png, jpeg, webp; 256 KB) shown beside members' names, or none to remove. Needs boost level 2.

permissions.description: Permission names, like manage_messages or ban_members. The role's permissions are replaced with these, plus the preset's when one is given.

preset.description: A vetted permission bundle: none, member, moderator, or admin (admin never includes Administrator). The role's permissions become the bundle plus any names in permissions.

secondary_color.description: A second hex color, so the role name shows a gradient from color to this one; none for a solid color. Needs the Enhanced Role Colors server feature.

name: update_role
title: Update role
